catalogue_metadata.policy: Every known source must remain visible as active, pending, blocked, licence-restricted, superseded or scientifically unsuitable. No source may silently disappear.

measurement_count_definitions.analysis_window_valid_observation_count: Quality-accepted numeric observations inside the exact AQ26 analysis window.
measurement_count_definitions.physical_site_count: Deduplicated physical monitoring locations, counted independently of pollutant streams.
measurement_count_definitions.provider_expected_slot_count: Provider timetable slots returned across selected series and lookback.
measurement_count_definitions.provider_missing_slot_count: Expected provider slots without a numeric observation.
measurement_count_definitions.provider_numeric_observation_count: Timestamped numeric provider observations; blank timetable slots excluded.
measurement_count_definitions.timeseries_count: Unique monitoring streams defined by source, station, pollutant, method, unit and averaging period.

scientific_boundary: API observations, regulatory records, models and satellite catalogues are screened as separate evidence classes. No single source establishes attribution, causation, permit breach, health impact or legal non-compliance.
